title: The successor step for zero-left addition drops a successor.
details: Logic and Proof version3.18.4, §17.4, proof of the proposition 0+n=n, prints 0+succ(n)=succ(0+n)=n. The induction hypothesis 0+n=n instead yields the final term succ(n). Taking n=0 makes the printed last equality 1=0. Replace the chain by 0+succ(n)=succ(0+n)=succ(n). The theorem and induction method are unchanged; the corpus uses the corrected chain. No upstream correction is inferred.
